sbx run <<'EOF'
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/bootstrap:/workspace/pylib
export TMPDIR=/tmp
mkdir -p /workspace/extracted
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, time, pymupdf
from PIL import Image
from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR
src='/workspace/documents'; out='/workspace/extracted'
engine=RapidOCR()
for name in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
    path=os.path.join(src,name)
    ext=os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower()
    text=''
    t0=time.time()
    if ext=='.pdf':
        doc=pymupdf.open(path)
        parts=[]
        for i,page in enumerate(doc):
            t=page.get_text()
            parts.append(f'--- page {i+1} ---\n'+t)
        text='\n'.join(parts)
        # OCR if very little text
        if len(text.strip())<30:
            parts=[]
            for i,page in enumerate(doc):
                pix=page.get_pixmap(dpi=200)
                img=Image.frombytes('RGB',[pix.width,pix.height],pix.samples)
                res,_=engine(img)
                ocr='\n'.join(x[1] for x in res) if res else ''
                parts.append(f'--- page {i+1} OCR ---\n'+ocr)
            text='\n'.join(parts)
        doc.close()
    else:
        res,_=engine(path)
        text='\n'.join(x[1] for x in res) if res else ''
    open(os.path.join(out,name+'.txt'),'w').write(text)
    print(f'\n===== {name} ({time.time()-t0:.1f}s) =====')
    print(text)
PY
EOF
